Verified one-second AI extensions in both directions, exact output sampling, full media checks and cancellation. App integration remains.
Integrated AI extensions and native controls; eight real cases pass acceptance, history and offline export. Added disk-full import checks and fixed read-only Render replies.
Fixed quiet AAC openings; verified 10,000 fractional-rate edits, 44 recipe exports, four HDR renders, native AAC timing and relocated packaging.
Closed DP-01: verified linked Originals, native recovery, durable history, concurrent inspection and reliable import completion.

Fractional MP4 apertures retain exact geometry through decoding, rendering, analysis, Vision, conditioning and proxies. Workspace 5,546 tests plus final focused checks, strict Clippy and release Render pass; DP-02 remains partial.

Interlaced Originals retain motion at exact field cadence. Workspace 5,555 tests, final focused checks, sanitizers, strict Clippy, release exports and packaged import/render pass. Telecine and the broader source/operation matrix remain; DP-02 stays partial.

Explicit H.264 telecine preserves two/three-field timing across threads and seeks. Workspace 5,560 tests, 124 sanitized source tests, strict Clippy, 155-picture release exports and packaged import/render/verification pass. Broader source-format and operation coverage remains; DP-02 stays partial.

SDR HEVC/High10 retain full/limited range and ten-bit precision. HEVC seeks discard stale output; proxy checks read sixteen-bit channels correctly. Workspace 5,567 tests, final media/proxy checks, sanitizers, strict lint, 72-picture/132-neighbor release exports and packaged verification pass. Broader formats and operation coverage remain; DP-02 stays partial.

SDR VP9 MP4 preserves eight/ten-bit color, altref and repeated-frame timing. Workspace 5,576 tests, 134 sanitized source tests, strict lint, 112-picture release verification and fresh-home packaged runs pass. WebM/Opus, HDR VP9, AV1 and the broader format/operation matrix remain; DP-02 stays partial.

Video-only SDR VP9 WebM/Matroska preserves color, anamorphic display and measured clocks. Final source/media regressions, 138 sanitized tests, strict lint, 166-picture release verification and 54-picture packaged runs pass. Opus/audio-bearing WebM and quantized-CFR proxies remain open; DP-02 and DP-16 stay partial.

Mono/stereo Opus WebM/Matroska preserves exact samples, offsets, pre-skip and header gain through pinned libopus. Workspace/UI regressions, 142 sanitized source tests, strict lint, 48-picture release verification and 60-picture/eight-sound packaged checks pass after repairing a proxy test retry. Broader formats and operations remain; DP-02 and DP-16 stay partial.
Verified MP3 sound import at all nine rates, exact cross-frame trims, 16 fixtures, full regression and sanitizer checks, and release/packaged exports at zero audio offset.

Verified integer8/16/24/32 and float32 WAV with exact scalar PCM, truthful non-finite failures, full regressions after two test corrections, 151 sanitized source tests, and six release plus three packaged exports at zero audio offset.

ProRes 422 Proxy/LT/Standard/HQ preserves ten-bit pictures, VFR, anamorphic display and both field orders. All 5,575 workspace, 1,097 UI and 157 sanitized source tests pass; ten release imports/exports verify 144 pictures and ten zero-offset audio windows, and packaged checks verify 48 pictures/three windows. Broader formats and operations remain.

AV1 Main preserves SDR/HDR, grain, super-resolution and measured VFR through pinned dav1d. Release checks import 29 inputs and verify 444 pictures/16 zero-offset audio windows; packaged checks verify 120 pictures/five windows. Regression and sanitizer evidence retained.

HDR VP9 imports preserve PQ/HLG and static metadata in MP4/WebM/Matroska. Fifteen release imports verify 180 pictures/nine zero-offset audio windows; packaged checks verify 84 pictures/four windows. Small HEVC output raster limits corrected and verified.

MP4 Opus preserves exact pre-skip, terminal trim, gain and offsets. Eleven release imports/exports verify 1,104 pictures/27 zero-offset audio windows; packaged checks verify 504 pictures/twelve windows. 170 sanitized source tests pass; the gate completes in parts with a retained proxy failure and passing isolated follow-up.

AV1/VP9 and Opus YouTube acquisition implemented and verified through real app-job and packaged imports. Both release exports pass 1,170 sampled pictures and 286 zero-offset audio windows. A packaged scene-cut quality failure is retained and under investigation; no threshold was lowered.

Fixed concurrent SDR scene-cut quality loss. Release and packaged exports pass all 7,012 decoded pictures and 286 zero-offset signal windows; regression, sanitizer and relocation checks pass. Unsupported software QP controls are refused explicitly.

Reversible source range and chroma interpretation implemented across preview, playback, export, analysis, tracking and AI conditioning. Full gate, 177 sanitized tests, affected replay follow-ups, release performance and 152-picture release and packaged exports pass. DP-02, DP-14 and DP-16 remain partial.

YouTube confirmation thumbnails implemented with bounded network/image work and accessible compact layouts. Real CDN/app-job checks, 125 workflow checks, UI tests and final bundle verification pass; the intermittent proxy failure remains recorded.

Proxy retry lifecycle isolated with retained encoder-fault evidence. YouTube size overflow and fast-transfer bounds fixed; 487 CLI tests, import and app checks, fresh bundle verification and a real 4K AV1/Opus import pass.
Closed DP-14: confined YouTube helpers, signed updates and packaged 4K imports verified. Corrected AAC priming admission in reordered-video duration proof; regression and release checks pass.
Implemented selected sound repair and corrected missing-media recovery. Linked sound moves preserve history; 1,106 app tests across runs, strict Clippy and final Metal recovery replays pass.

Closed DP-15: verified missing/corrupt sound export refusal, identical repair, portable linked sound export, explicit container-audio import and deduplication. All 360 picture comparisons, six zero-offset signal windows and 36 focused store tests pass.

Closed DP-02: added combined source-format editing tests and reconciled the exact-time contract. Forty release exports pass 1,040 independent picture identities, 36 zero-offset signal windows and exact terminal sample counts; strict Clippy passes.

Implemented optional persistent VideoToolbox decoding and exact bounded surface transfer. All 339 source/media and 182 native sanitizer tests pass; 5,760 longer-clip picture comparisons and 800 random seeks match. Hardware seeks are slower, so normal preview remains on software and DP-16/DP-24 stay open.
Prepared Original and Edit loop return pictures. Real-device 1080p60 and 4K30 loops drop zero pictures; exact VFR, context, long-held-picture and decoder-swap regressions pass.

Retained Original decode-ahead across Generated Holds and reused accepted decoders on re-entry. Three selection-loop laps match all 90 reference pictures; both prepared returns, cleanup, 41 worker tests and strict Clippy pass. Cold Generated entry and full-resolution measurements remain open.
